pr_title: ipaddr('address'): Treat IPv6 /127 just like IPv4 /31
pr_body:
##### SUMMARY

Just like excluding the network address doesn't really make sense for
an IPv4 /31 range neither does it for an IPv6 /127 range. While the
indirect broadcast test only covers the IPv4 case the explicit size
test covers both the IPv4 case and the IPv6 case.

Fixes #62740

##### ISSUE TYPE
- Bugfix Pull Request

##### COMPONENT NAME
ipaddr
pr_comments: Works like a charm! Thank you very much!
I'll have a look at the `_address_prefix_query()` method as well as the unit testing.
Hi andreaso! Any progress on this issue?
No progress. Some other things got in the way, and then my brain context switched out of Ansible development. Might get back in context during the later half of my Christmas vacation.
Don't see myself getting around to this PR anytime soon. Someone else will have to create a new one.

issue_context.title: ipaddr('address') not working with ipv6 subnet address
issue_context.body:
##### SUMMARY
The following `{{ '2222:2222::0/127'|ipaddr('address') }}` returns an empty string instead of '2222:2222::0'. 

##### ISSUE TYPE
- Bug Report

##### COMPONENT NAME
ipaddr

##### ANSIBLE VERSION
```
ansible 2.10.0.dev0
  config file = /home/tom/ansible/ansible.cfg
  configured module search path = [u'/home/tom/.ansible/plugins/modules', u'/usr/share/ansible/plugins/modules']
  ansible python module location = /home/tom/PycharmProjects/ansible/lib/ansible
  executable location = /home/tom/PycharmProjects/ansible/bin/ansible
  python version = 2.7.15+ (default, Jul  9 2019, 16:51:35) [GCC 7.4.0]
```

##### CONFIGURATION
```
DEFAULT_ROLES_PATH(/home/tom/ansible/ansible.cfg) = [u'/home/tom/ansible/roles']
HOST_KEY_CHECKING(/home/tom/ansible/ansible.cfg) = False
PERSISTENT_COMMAND_TIMEOUT(/home/tom/ansible/ansible.cfg) = 120
RETRY_FILES_ENABLED(/home/tom/ansible/ansible.cfg) = False
```

##### OS / ENVIRONMENT
ubuntu-18.04
Ran into the issue using ansible-2.7.6 but also in the latest dev as shown above.

##### STEPS TO REPRODUCE
```yaml
- hosts: localhost
  tasks:
  - debug: msg="{{ '2222:2222::0/127'|ipaddr('address') }}"   # out => ""
  - debug: msg="{{ '2222:2222::1/127'|ipaddr('address') }}"   # out => "2222:2222::1"
  - debug: msg="{{ '10.0.0.0/31'|ipaddr('address') }}"        # out => "10.0.0.0"
  - debug: msg="{{ '10.0.0.1/31'|ipaddr('address') }}"        # out => "10.0.0.1"
```
`ansible-playbook this_playbook.yml`

##### EXPECTED RESULTS
"2222:2222::0"

##### ACTUAL RESULTS
""

review_comments:
Text in controller-side code should be the native text type since `str()` returns `bytes` on Python 2 and `unicode` on Python 3. I know this filter uses `str()` extensively, and that should be changed. But we can start small.
```suggestion
        return to_text(v.ip)
```

Add `from ansible.module_utils._text import to_text`.
I'd rather do the `to_text()` fix as a separate PR, and then deal with the all the returns of the ipaddr filter in one go. Feels much more consistent that way.
